description:
### ✨ Overview

This mod replaces Akshan with Ghost from Call of Duty: Modern Warfare.
He wields a bunch of guns from Counter-Strike: Global Offensive.

#

### ✨ Additional information

The mod replaces the Base Akshan skin.

#

### ✨ Features

* New model and textures
* New voiceover
* New sound effects
